outcome: Trends in cesarean section rates over time
cohort: Pregnancies in Turkey over a 4-year period
finding: The study found an overall increasing trend in cesarean section rates, particularly driven by an increase in the R5 group (previous cesarean section), highlighting the importance of analyzing cesarean sections using the Robson Classification system.
mod_finding: The study found that previous cesarean sections in Robson's groups R1-R4 led to subsequent pregnancies resulting in cesarean sections, contributing to the increasing C-section rate.
